question: Who presented the Digital Payments Award 2024-25 to India Post Payments Bank for its efforts in digital inclusion?

options.text: Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman and Shri Pankaj Chaudhary
Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw and Dr. Bhagwat Karad
Smt. Anupriya Patel and Shri Rajeev Chandrasekhar
Shri Dharmendra Pradhan and Shri Hardeep Singh Puri

solution:
The correct answer is __**Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman and Shri Pankaj Chaudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Digital Payments Award 2024-25** was presented to recognize and celebrate the outstanding contributions of various institutions toward building a **robust digital payment ecosystem** in India.
